about_the_game:
This is a Mithril Satchel reserved for the high-ranking members of the Mithril Order. It contains a textured cloak, a lantern burning with a special cyan flame, as well as supplies.
Mithril adherents are rumored to identify each other by the cyan flame and cloak when they cannot reveal their identities. When the adventure begins, setting out with a satchel brimming with supplies is undoubtedly the right choice.

This DLC contains:

- Unlock the exclusive torch [Mithril Lantern]
- Unlock the exclusive cloak [Mithril Cloak]

[Healing items]:
- Bandage x15
- Healing Potion x15

[Throwable Items]:
- Incendiary Flask x3
- Thunderclap Flask x3
- Stoneshaping Flask x3
- Smokescreen Flask x3
